# Perplexity API Changelog — captured 2026-07-06

## May 2026 [top dated entry; cached — still newest]
- Finance Search tool for Agent API: structured financial data (quotes, financials, earnings, analyst estimates, segment KPIs, ETF constituents, OHLCV, pre/after-hours); model autonomously selects fields.

## April 2026 [cached]
- Agent API + third-party models: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, Grok 4.20 Reasoning.
- API key one-time-reveal security model.
- n8n + OpenClaw integrations; AWS Marketplace; GET /v1/models endpoint.

## March 2026 [cached]
- Models: GPT-5.4, NVIDIA Nemotron, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro. Gemini 2.5 removed. /v1/agent canonical.

## Feb 2026: Agent API + Embeddings API GA. Dec 2025: Media Classifier; Search API max_tokens/last_updated_filter/Vercel SDK. Nov 2025: Pro Search GA; MCP Server one-click install (Cursor/VS Code/Claude Desktop). (earlier history cached.)

API reference (/v1/agent) tools: web search (domain/date/geo filters), Finance search, People search, URL fetch (≤10), Sandbox execution, custom function tools, and **`mcp` tool — connect user-supplied remote MCP servers (Streamable HTTP/HTTPS, optional auth tokens/headers, allowed_tools allowlist; auto-executes all tool calls, no approval workflow)**. Presets: fast-search, pro-search, deep-research. Reasoning effort low/med/high/xhigh/max. research loop max_steps 1-10; SSE streaming. [mcp tool + xhigh/max still in reference, still NOT confirmed by any dated changelog entry.]
